elements.name: wide night view of a busy avenue
pavements packed with people as dark shapes
tall concrete buildings with many lit windows
young man seen from behind, small in the lower part of the frame
man standing at the roadside looking at the scene

notes: The young man fills more than half the frame height when he should be small in the lower part, so shrink him to roughly a quarter of the height to restore the wide view, and paint the pavement crowd as dark silhouettes rather than detailed figures.
